digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC atomic executor integration — legacy-default seam
propositions: Exact summary-only mutations must route through a constructor-injected legacy-default selector that bypasses generic retry, while mixed-field mutations remain unchanged on the legacy path

Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) must map to the legacy result surface with key set, advance the ADR-0026 baseline using the routed mutation's fields["summary"] value, and preserve all existing telemetry shapes

Terminal dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and further non-success outcomes) must emit exactly one redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points, never advance baseline/provenance, and allow batch continuation
The selector defaults to legacy behavior, requires no config or environment key, and is only activated by explicit test enable
Terminal outcomes must carry retry_not_before for observability in the manifest but persist no S1 deferral
ADR 0103 must name S3 as the sole production cutover owner, fuse/deferral consumer, and bridge-retirement owner
